extension.description: This extension gives you all the tools you need to design, automate and optimize workflows from simple tasks to complex enterprise processes.
editor.webServiceClients: Axon Ivy Web Service Client Editor
setting.title: Axon Ivy
setting.engine.runByExtension: Configure whether a local Axon Ivy Engine will be run by this extension. If set true, you can specify `#axonivy.engine.releaseTrain#`. If set false, you have to define `#axonivy.engine.url#`.
setting.engine.releaseTrain: Release train of Axon Ivy Engine to be used as Developer Engine. Expected to be a release tag like '14.0' or an absolute path to an existing Axon Ivy Engine.
setting.engine.url: Url of the Axon Ivy Engine that will be used as backend. Only relevant if `#axonivy.engine.runByExtension#` is set to false.
setting.engine.vmArgs: Specifies extra VM arguments used to launch the Axon Ivy Engine. Eg. use `-agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,address=*:8000,suspend=n` to enable remote debugging.
setting.localMcp.enabled: Enable local loopback MCP endpoints for third-party harness automation clients. Use only on trusted machines.
setting.localMcp.host: Host interface for the local MCP server. Keep this on loopback for security.
setting.localMcp.port: TCP port for the local MCP server.
setting.localMcp.exposeAllTools: Expose all IDE language model tools via the local MCP endpoint. If false, only tools contributed by this extension are exposed.
setting.project.excludePattern: A Glob Pattern that is used to exclude Axon Ivy projects during detection. [Learn more about Glob Pattern](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns)
setting.project.maximumNumber: Maximum number of Axon Ivy projects that will be detected.
setting.process.animation.animate: Specify whether processes should be animated during preview.
setting.process.animation.showAll: Show and open all touched processes (default)
setting.process.animation.currentEditor: Follow only in the current editor on top
setting.process.animation.mode: Choose which processes to follow during animation. Turn off **Animate processes during preview** to stop following entirely.
setting.workspaceValidation: Configure which validators are enabled workspace-wide. Individual validators can be disabled in the respective editor settings.
setting.browser: Specify which browser to use for opening Axon Ivy content.
debugger.label: Axon Ivy Process Debugger
debugger.host: Host name of the Axon Ivy Engine DAP server. Defaults to the configured engine host.
debugger.port: Port of the Axon Ivy Engine DAP server. Defaults to the configured debug port.
debugger.workspaceFolder: Absolute path of the workspace folder to expose to the Axon Ivy debug adapter. Defaults to the selected workspace folder.
debugger.snippetDescription: Attach the Axon Ivy process debugger to a running engine DAP server.
